Thank you for viewing! 

This is a set of 150 Pokémon cards (Pokéca) mainly of R (Rare) rarity or higher. It 
includes popular legendary and mythical Pokémon, as well as AR (Art Rare) cards! 

★All cards will be stored and shipped in sleeves! 

[Featured Cards (Examples)]
・Lugia
・Team Rocket's Articuno
・Suicune
・Raikou
・Entei
・Zapdos
・Zekrom
・Virizion
・Victini
・Shaymin 
…and many more, a luxurious lineup! (See second image) 

[Contents]
・Pokémon card set: 150 cards in total 
(all sleeved) 

[Condition] 
Stored in sleeves immediately after opening. 
To prevent any issues, please consider them all as "for play". 
There are no bends or major scratches, but please only purchase if you understand that they have been stored by an amateur. 

[Shipping] 
We will pack and ship carefully, taking thorough measures to prevent water damage and bending. 

Immediate purchase is OK! 
Thank you.
